title: On the Relation between Rectified Flows and Optimal Transport
tldr_zh: 反例证明梯度约束 reflow 有非最优不动点、损失趋零不蕴含最优；Liu22 Thm 5.6 需加连通支撑假设
tldr_en: Counterexamples show gradient-constrained reflow has non-optimal fixed points and vanishing loss does not imply optimality; Liu22 Thm 5.6 needs connected-support assumption.
key_numbers: Smoothed rectification from non-optimal fixed point: transport distance 2.84->2.79 (c0=0, stuck) vs 2.68->2.66 (c0=0.2); optimum 2.66 (Appendix E, Table 1)
Cor. 17: loss < eps and W2^2(mu0^c, mu1) < eps but E||X1^c - X0^c||^2 > 4 - eps
Thm 18: min_i L^(i) = O(1/K + mean c_K) for noise-injected rectification
Thm 3(ii): independent Gaussian coupling with jointly diagonalizable covariances -> one rectification step gives the unique OT coupling
MLP 3x512, Adam 40000 steps, batch 256 for 2D verification (Appendix D)
